#!/bin/bash
# WINDOW stage parent SCREEN (not adoptable): r3 synth/floorplan reused, PDN without the column macro grid (columns
# are being re-hardened M2..M6), place + CTS without CTS repair, measured insertion, setup class screen.
set -uo pipefail
S=/srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/takeover-ds/window-stage; N=$S/screen_r4; W=$N/work/orfs; SRC=$S/src_7aa74e8da
IMG=openroad/orfs:asap7lock; B=$(ls -d $W/results/asap7/*/base)
run() { docker run --rm -v $SRC:/src:ro -v $W:/work -w /OpenROAD-flow-scripts/flow $IMG bash -lc "source /OpenROAD-flow-scripts/env.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; $1"; }
run "SKIP_CTS_REPAIR_TIMING=1 make DESIGN_CONFIG=/work/config.mk WORK_HOME=/work FLOW_VARIANT=base NUM_CORES=16 cts" > $N/a_cts.log 2>&1; echo $? > $N/a_cts.rc
python3 $N/ck_insertion.py --base $B --clock core_clk --image $IMG --output $N/calib.json > $N/calib.env 2>$N/calib.err
docker run --rm -v $N:/n -v $B:/b:ro -e ODB=/b/4_1_cts.odb -e SDC=/b/4_cts.sdc -e PAR=1 -e SMAX=0 $IMG bash -lc "source /OpenROAD-flow-scripts/env.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; openroad -exit -no_splash /n/classes.tcl" > $N/classes_cts.txt 2>&1
python3 $N/cls.py $N/classes_cts.txt 40 > $N/classes_cts_summary.txt 2>&1
echo done > $N/terminal.exit
